triggers.name: new_message
triggers.title: New message in topic (Deprecated)
triggers.help: Kafka connection settings are determined by the on-prem agent configuration. Note: This trigger works only with agents older than 2.20.0.

input.name: topic
input.label: Topic
input.hint: Select a topic

input.name: group
input.label: Group ID
input.hint: Use specified Kafka consumer group.

input.name: schema_source
input.label: Message schema source
input.hint: Select where your message schema is defined. To retrieve schemas from schema-registry, configure on-prem agent accordingly.

input.name: workato_schema_id
input.label: Message schema
input.hint: {{#if input.schema_source == "onprem"}} Select from your schemas. {{#else}} Select from your common data models. Create new schema here . {{#if input.workato_schema_id}} Update schema here . {{/if}} {…

input.name: key_schema_type
input.label: Key schema type
input.hint: Select the schema of message key. To use schemas from schema-registry, configure on-prem agent accordingly.

input.name: key_schema_id
input.label: Key schema
input.hint: Select from your schemas.

input.name: auto_offset
input.label: Initial offset
input.hint: What to do when there is no initial offset in Kafka or if the current offset does not exist any more on the server (e.g. because that data has been deleted).
